Name: Spelunky
Overview: Spelunky is a critically acclaimed roguelike 2D platformer created by Derek Yu. Players explore procedurally generated, destructible caves filled with treasure, traps, and monsters. Famous for its punishing difficulty and permadeath, the game requires players to learn from their mistakes and master the environment to survive.Core GameplayPermadeath: If you lose all your health, you start the game from the beginning with only your base equipment.Randomized Levels: Every playthrough generates a unique cave system, meaning you have to adapt rather than memorize layouts.
